messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — incoming security questionnaire from NimbusPay (SIG/CAIQ). I uploaded what they sent: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/nimbus-inbound. Need security review + answers for the buyer by Mon 4/1. Can we assign an owner?
security_bot: New intake created: ticket INC-3427. Currently unassigned. Priority: High. :rotating_light:
sanjay_se: I can handle the integration/POC questions. Need to confirm whether they require a dedicated VPC for the POC. @kevin_security can you take the controls portion (SIG/CAIQ answers)?
kevin_security: I can own the SIG responses. Quick asks: 1) Do we have the CAIQ as an Excel (form) or just PDF? 2) Any data residency constraints? Tentatively blocking ~6h this week to complete. :clock1:
tess_cs: Customer replied — data must stay in eu-west1. Also they want to validate PII redaction in the POC (canary). I'll upload their CAIQ excel when they finish converting it.
maria_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks. Also buyer asked about POC pricing for dedicated capacity — can we offer a short burst for testing? @sanjay_se any quick answer so I can reply?
sanjay_se: We can provision a 2-week dedicated pool at a reduced POC rate; requires finance signoff. I'll draft a short quote (ETA today) and loop in billing.
kevin_security: Started reviewing the sheet. Question 12 (Access Controls) — do we have the SSO mapping docs for customer-facing consoles? If not, I'll mark as "in progress" and attach our runbook. Also need confirmation on KMS usage for customer-managed keys.
maria_sales: Deadline moved by buyer to Tue 4/2 EOD. Can security hit that?
kevin_security: Yes if we get the CAIQ Excel + SSO mapping details today. Otherwise we'll request a 48hr extension. I'll post a status update by EOD either way.
security_bot: Status update: owner assigned -> kevin_security; ETA -> 2024-04-02T23:59Z; estimated effort -> 5h.
tess_cs: CAIQ uploaded: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nimbus_caiq.xlsx — shared with team and the buyer confirmed eu-west1.
kevin_security: Got the file. Starting answers now. I'll flag any technical blockers (SSO/KMS) and call out items that need design input from @sanjay_se.
maria_sales: Great. I'll note this in the deal tracker and ping the buyer that we're on it. If they press on SLA wording or dedicated capacity terms, I'll escalate.
kevin_security: Quick note while I dig in: Question 27 (Logging) — do we commit to log retention >90d for POC? We usually default to 30d for POCs unless customer purchases extended retention. Marking as "needs product confirmation".
sanjay_se: For POC we can offer default 30d. If they need 90d for evaluation, we can add a temporary retention policy in the staging environment; need approval for extra storage.
security_bot: Action logged: INC-3427 -> kevin_security (owner), assignee_group -> security-ops, due -> 2024-04-02T23:59Z.
maria_sales: Thanks everyone. Please update the thread with any major blockers. I'll follow up with the buyer re: timeline and the dedicated pool quote. :pray:
